abstract: When a technology becomes the new standard, the firms that are leaders in producing this technology gain a competitive advantage. Matching the semantic content of patents to standard documents, we show that firms closer to the new technology standard increase their market share and sales. In addition, if they operate in a competitive market, these firms also increase their R&D expenditure. Yet, these effects are temporary since standardization creates a common technological basis for everyone, which allows followers to catch up and the economy to grow.
abstract_zh: 当一项技术成为新标准时，生产该技术的领先企业将获得竞争优势。通过将专利的语义内容与标准文件相匹配，我们发现更接近新技术标准的企业市场份额和销售额有所增加。此外，若这些企业处于竞争性市场中，它们还会增加研发支出。然而，这些效应是暂时的，因为标准化为所有参与者建立了共同的技术基础，使追随者得以追赶，并推动经济增长。
title: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
title_zh: 符合标准的专利：关于竞争、创新与增长的企业层面证据

abstract: Using a novel macro-finance model, we infer jointly the equilibrium real interest rate rt∗, trend inflation, interest rate expectations, and bond risk premia for the United States. In the model rt∗ plays a dual macro-finance role: as the benchmark real interest rate that closes the output gap and as the time-varying long-run real interest rate that determines the level of the yield curve. Our estimated rt∗ declines over the last decade, with estimation uncertainty being relatively contained. We show that both macro and financial information is important to infer rt∗. Accounting for the secular decline in interest rates renders term premia more stable than those based on stationary yield curve models.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的宏观金融模型，联合推断美国的均衡实际利率rt∗、趋势通胀、利率预期及债券风险溢价。在该模型中，rt∗扮演着双重宏观金融角色：既是缩小产出缺口的基准实际利率，又是决定收益率曲线水平的时间变化长期实际利率。我们的估计显示，过去十年rt∗有所下降，且估计不确定性相对可控。我们证明，宏观与金融信息对于推断rt∗均至关重要。考虑利率的长期下降趋势，使得期限溢价相较于基于平稳收益率曲线模型所得结果更为稳定。
title: Estimating the Natural Rate of Interest in a Macro-Finance Yield Curve Model
title_zh: 宏观金融收益率曲线模型中自然利率的估计

abstract: We investigate whether time pressure exacerbates or mitigates bubbles in laboratory experiments. We find that under high time pressure price volatility is lower and market prices are closer to their fundamental value. This is due to participants using simpler adaptive forecasting strategies, instead of the self-reinforcing extrapolative expectations that they use under low time pressure, and which are conducive to the emergence of bubbles. In addition, by substantially increasing the number of decision periods in our experiment, we find that in the long run prices tend to converge to their fundamental value, also in the absence of time pressure.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验探究时间压力是加剧还是缓解泡沫现象。研究发现，在高时间压力下，价格波动性更低，市场价格更接近其基础价值。这是因为参与者采用了更简单的适应性预测策略，而非低时间压力下使用的自我强化外推预期——后者正是导致泡沫产生的因素。此外，通过大幅增加实验中的决策周期数，我们发现长期来看，即使没有时间压力，价格也趋于收敛至基础价值。
title: Time pressure reduces financial bubbles: evidence from a forecasting experiment
title_zh: 时间压力减少金融泡沫：来自预测实验的证据

abstract: Human beings often combat the free-riding tendency by establishing punishment institutions in social dilemmas. This paper investigates the interaction between formal and informal punishment institutions and explores how their combination affects cooperation. The experiment incorporates the Formal Punishment Treatment (FT), Informal Punishment Treatment (IPT), and their combination (F&IPT) to analyze their impact on contributions to public goods. The results show that the combination of formal and informal punishment (F&IPT) leads to significantly higher contributions compared to both the formal punishment institution (FT) and the informal punishment institution (IPT) alone, demonstrating a complementary relationship between the two. This study highlights the complementary relationship between formal and informal punishment mechanisms in sustaining higher levels of cooperation in public goods provision.
abstract_zh: 人类常通过在社会困境中建立惩罚机制来遏制搭便车行为。本文研究了正式与非正式惩罚机制之间的相互作用，并探讨两者结合如何影响合作水平。实验设置了正式惩罚机制（FT）、非正式惩罚机制（IPT）及其组合机制（F&IPT），分析其对公共品贡献的影响。结果表明，正式与非正式惩罚的组合机制（F&IPT）带来的贡献水平显著高于单独使用正式惩罚机制（FT）或非正式惩罚机制（IPT），两者呈现互补关系。本研究揭示了正式与非正式惩罚机制在维持公共品供给中更高合作水平方面的互补性。
title: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution
title_zh: 正式惩罚制度与非正式集中惩罚制度之间的互动

abstract: Abstract Not very. We find even the most destructive weather disasters over the last quarter century had only modest effects on U.S. banks' performance. This stability seems endogenous rather than a mere reflection of federal disaster aid, as disasters tend to increase loan demand, which helps offset losses and boosts profits. Local banks avoid mortgage lending where floods are more common than official flood maps would predict, suggesting local knowledge may also mitigate disaster impacts. Our findings inform ongoing assessments of the physical risks to banks from climate change.
abstract_zh: 摘要 并非如此。我们发现，过去四分之一世纪里，即使最具破坏性的天气灾害对美国银行业绩的影响也仅属温和。这种稳定性似乎是内生的，而非仅仅是联邦灾害援助的反映，因为灾害往往会增加贷款需求，这有助于抵消损失并提升利润。地方银行在洪水发生频率高于官方洪水地图预测的地区避免发放抵押贷款，这表明地方知识也可能减轻灾害影响。我们的发现为当前评估气候变化对银行物理风险的工作提供了参考。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: How Bad Are Weather Disasters for Banks?
title_zh: 天气灾害对银行的影响有多严重？

abstract: This paper develops a theory of when annuitization improves or reduces social welfare. The analysis is based on a small open economy with exogenous prices, populated by overlapping generations of non-altruistic agents. Annuities provide longevity risk insurance and above-market returns, but also reduce accidental bequests that transfer resources from the old to the young. I show that the welfare trade-off between these channels is governed by the interest rate: above a threshold, the cost of reducing bequests dominates and no annuitization is socially optimal; below it, partial annuitization improves welfare. Socially optimal allocations can be implemented by mandating a savings portfolio with a predetermined share invested in annuities. Governments that instead mandate annuities through fully funded pensions cannot replicate these allocations, even when annuity markets are missing and agents cannot borrow against future benefits. Although derived for small open economies, the results provide a benchmark for identifying when annuitization raises or lowers welfare and presumably extend to closed economies, where the boundary may still depend on the rate of return but now through threshold values of the parameters that determine it.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，探讨年金化何时能增进或降低社会福利。分析基于一个价格外生的小型开放经济体，其中居住着无利他主义的世代交叠个体。年金提供长寿风险保险及高于市场水平的回报，但同时也减少了将资源从老年一代转移至年轻一代的意外遗产。研究表明，这些渠道间的福利权衡由利率决定：当利率高于某一阈值时，减少遗产的代价占据主导，此时不进行年金化是社会最优选择；而当利率低于该阈值时，部分年金化能提升社会福利。社会最优配置可通过强制规定储蓄组合中投资于年金的预定比例来实现。相比之下，即使年金市场缺失且个体无法以未来收益为抵押借款，政府通过完全基金制养老金强制推行年金也无法复制这些最优配置。尽管结论源于小型开放经济模型，但为识别年金化提升或降低福利的条件提供了基准，并可能推广至封闭经济，其中边界仍可能依赖于回报率，但此时是通过决定回报率的参数阈值来体现。
title: Social welfare effects of annuitization in small open economies
title_zh: 小开放经济中年金化的社会福利效应
